verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe the core capability: natural-language code commands, an agent that operates across editor/terminal/browser, multi-folder Projects giving codebase-wide context, and Planning Mode/Artifacts producing implementation plans and code diffs across files with human approval. Community confirms it functions as a Cursor-like coding agent, but other hands-on reports describe the model/harness as slow or subpar for actual coding tasks, tempering confidence. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks or detailed multi-file bug-fix walkthroughs, and consistent positive quality reports (some users found code generation quality lacking).
